title: Rokhlin properties in homeomorphism groups of compact metric spaces
summary: We develop a general framework for studying generic homeomorphisms of compact metric spaces using combinatorial amalgamation methods inspired by Fraïssé theory. Our approach combines Rosendal's criterion for comeager conjugacy classes with combinatorial codings of compact spaces arising from the Bartoš-Bice-Vignati duality. We introduce a new amalgamation property, called weak minimal amalgamation, formulated in suitable paracategories encoding local dynamical data of homeomorphisms.
